Tessa — quick technical readout (working notes):

Observations from first 20m:
- Telemetry: sustained queue depth on ClearWave's dedicated shard (pool-17) with token backlog growth starting 07:38 PT.
- Error pattern: 502/504s from the inference gateway during peaks; model servers are returning OOM-fallbacks intermittently.
- No kernel regressions detected in the last deploy window (no rollouts at 07:00).
- Likely cause: sudden traffic spike from customer batch jobs + lower-than-expected headroom due to capacity drift on pool-17 (we're at ~92% allocation vs expected 70% baseline).

Immediate remediation we've initiated:
A) Short-term (minutes):
  - Enabled conservative queue-priority: throttle non-critical routes for ClearWave by lowering concurrency for dev/ingest routes (reduces noise).
  - Activated KV-prefix cache for settlement route to cut token generation by ~15% (experimentally validated).
  - Opened a hot patch to increase per-worker memory cap to reduce OOM fallbacks — rolling now (ETA 8–12m).

B) Fallbacks if short-term doesn't stabilize (need authorization):
  - Route clearwave-settlements -> smaller quantized model variant (compatible, lower latency but slightly lower quality) — needs explicit customer opt-in or temporary override by CS.
  - Grant one-time burst credit to allow provisioning of 4 extra GPUs into pool-17 for 2 hours (requires finance/proc sign-off).

C) Longer-term:
  - Run a postmortem on reservation drift and autoscaler policies for dedicated pools.
  - Propose a safety buffer policy for high-SLA accounts to prevent drift >15%.

Requesting:
- Marissa: authorize one-time burst up to 2 hours (we can auto-reconcile credits against DEAL-7834). If you want, I can list estimated cost (ballpark $3.2k/hour).
- Jonas: create INF-9123 and tag on-call for further root cause details.

I'll post an updated metrics snapshot in 15m.

-David
